card.name: Small words before an expected "en" word
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, would, are, and, a comma) that come right after a noun or verb phrase. The next word is likely to begin with "en", such as "enforce", "engage", "endure" or "ensure".

modes.label: to before a verb
modes.description: The word "to" opens an infinitive of purpose after a noun or verb.
modes.example: Locals then built Linh Son Pagoda<< to>> worship the four-handed Buddha.

modes.label: Auxiliary or linking verb
modes.description: A verb such as would, are or began follows a plural or group subject in general prose.
modes.example: one tribe of black Africans<< would>> wage war against another.

modes.label: Conjunction or comma
modes.description: A comma or "and" ends a clause or list item in running prose.
modes.example: In places bereft of Islam, injustice<<,>> insecurity and instability prevail.

card.writes: It slightly boosts words that start with "en" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words where the next word could well begin with "en".
